


```{r}
points=list(c(-1,1,1,2,0),
         c(-2.5,2.5,2,1,2),
         c(2,4,1,1,6),
         c(5,3,2,5,9))

x=c()
x_prime=c()
y=c()
y_prime=c()
t=c()
for(i in 1:length(points)){
  x[i]=points[[i]][1]
  y[i]=points[[i]][2]
  x_prime[i]=points[[i]][3]
  y_prime[i]=points[[i]][4]
  t[i]=points[[i]][5]
}


#VF_1=function(v)c(v[2],-v[1])
VF_1 = function(v) c(v[1]*(1/2*v[1]^2+1/2)+v[2]*(-v[1]+(1/2*v[2]-1)*v[2]+1/2),1/2*v[1]^2*v[2]+v[1]*(-1/2*v[2]^2+v[2]-1/2)+1/2*v[2]-1)

p=function(p_a,p_b,a,b,p_a_prime,p_b_prime,t){
  c=c(2*((t-a)/(b-a))^3-3*((t-a)/(b-a))^2+1,
      (((t-a)/(b-a))^3)-2*(((t-a)/(b-a))^2)+((t-a)/(b-a)),
      -2*(((t-a)/(b-a))^3)+3*(((t-a)/(b-a))^2),
      ((t-a)/(b-a))^3-((t-a)/(b-a))^2)
  b=c(p_a,
      (b-a)*p_a_prime,
      p_b,
      (b-a)*p_b_prime)
  return(t(c)%*%b)
}

p_prime=function(p_a,p_b,a,b,p_a_prime,p_b_prime,t){
  c=c(6*((t-a)/(b-a))^2-6*((t-a)/(b-a)),
      (3*((t-a)/(b-a))^2)-4*(((t-a)/(b-a)))+1,
      -6*(((t-a)/(b-a))^2)+6*((t-a)/(b-a)),
      (3*(((t-a)/(b-a)))^2)-2*((t-a)/(b-a)))
  b=c(p_a,
      (b-a)*p_a_prime,
      p_b,
      (b-a)*p_b_prime)
  return(t(c)%*%b)
}

h=function(n,time){ #i could make this better by having the time determine what section it is
  vf=VF_1
  x_a=x[n]
  x_b=x[n+1]
  y_a=y[n]
  y_b=y[n+1]
  x_a_prime=x_prime[n]
  x_b_prime = x_prime[n+1]
  y_a_prime = y_prime[n]
  y_b_prime = y_prime[n+1]
  a=t[n]
  b=t[n+1]
  
  p_x=p(p_a=x_a,p_b=x_b,a=a,b=b,p_a_prime = x_a_prime,p_b_prime = x_b_prime,t=time)
  p_y=p(p_a=y_a,p_b=y_b,a=a,b=b,p_a_prime =y_a_prime,p_b_prime = y_b_prime,t=time)
  p_x_prime=p_prime(p_a=x_a,p_b=x_b,a=a,b=b,p_a_prime = x_a_prime,p_b_prime = x_b_prime,t=time)
  p_y_prime=p_prime(p_a=y_a,p_b=y_b,a=a,b=b,p_a_prime =y_a_prime,p_b_prime = y_b_prime,t=time)

  return(t(vf(c(p_x,p_y)))%*%c(p_x_prime,p_y_prime))
}

r=function(n,time){
  x_a=x[n]
  x_b=x[n+1]
  y_a=y[n]
  y_b=y[n+1]
  x_a_prime=x_prime[n]
  x_b_prime = x_prime[n+1]
  y_a_prime = y_prime[n]
  y_b_prime = y_prime[n+1]
  a=t[n]
  b=t[n+1]
  
  p_x_prime=p_prime(p_a=x_a,p_b=x_b,a=a,b=b,p_a_prime = x_a_prime,p_b_prime = x_b_prime,t=time)
  p_y_prime=p_prime(p_a=y_a,p_b=y_b,a=a,b=b,p_a_prime =y_a_prime,p_b_prime = y_b_prime,t=time)
  
  return(sqrt((p_x_prime^2)+(p_y_prime^2)))

}

simpsons_method_h=function(n){
  a=t[n]
  b=t[n+1]
  ((b-a)/6)*(h(n,a)+4*h(n,(a+b)/2)+h(n,b))
}

simpsons_method_r=function(n){
  a=t[n]
  b=t[n+1]
  ((b-a)/6)*(r(n,a)+4*r(n,(a+b)/2)+r(n,b))
}


objective_func=0
for(i in 1:(length(t)-1)){
  objective_func=objective_func+(simpsons_method_h(i)/(simpsons_method_r(i)))
  #objective_func=objective_func+(simpsons_method_h(i))

}
print(objective_func)
```
```{r}
dist_path=c()
dist_direct=c()
for(i in 1:(length(t)-1)){
  dist_path[i]=simpsons_method_r(i)
  print(paste0("segment ",i," has a path distance of ",dist_path[i]))
  
  dist_direct[i]=sqrt((x[i+1]-x[i])^2+(y[i+1]-y[i])^2)
  print(paste0("segment ",i," has a direct distance of ",dist_direct[i]))
  #objective_func=objective_func+(simpsons_method_h(i))
}
percent_of_path=dist_path/sum(dist_path)
percent_of_path


dist_direct
```

```{r}
library(optimx)

objective <- function(v) {
  x_prime <<- v[1:4]
  y_prime <<- v[5:8]
  #x = #add perameters for knots that are not data points
  #y = 
  #t = variable times of extra knot locations

  objective_func=0
  for(i in 1:(length(t)-1)){
    objective_func=objective_func+(simpsons_method_h(i)/(simpsons_method_r(i)))
    #objective_func=objective_func+(simpsons_method_h(i))
  }

  return(-objective_func) 
}

result <- optim(
  par = rep(0, 8),  #make this little more complicated so that the location of the extra knots and times are between on the direct path between the data points
  fn = objective,
  method = "L-BFGS-B",
  lower = rep(-10, 8), # add more tailored bounds 
  upper = rep(10, 8)
)

-result$value
result$par
```

```{r}
  path_y[i]=p(p_a=y_a,p_b=y_b,a=a,b=b,p_a_prime =y_a_prime,p_b_prime = y_b_prime,t=time[i])

}
```
